memo.title: Enterprise RAG Sprint 3 Status Update
summary_points: Backend document ingestion endpoints are complete, but vector embedding latency is high at 4 seconds, exceeding the 1-second target.
Sneha is working on a fix for the latency issue by implementing a sliding window chunking strategy, which requires 3 days.
Karthik will build a batch upload endpoint by Tuesday to enable large-scale testing, with Arjun assisting on the authentication part.
The frontend search UI is 70% complete and is currently blocked waiting for the API response schema from Sneha.
Meena has completed ingestion test cases, finding 3 bugs (1 critical, 2 medium). The critical bug is fixed, and Karthik will fix the medium ones by Wednesday.
The team is working towards a client demo on April 14th, making the latency issue the highest priority risk.
key_decisions: Sneha will implement a sliding window chunking strategy to reduce embedding latency.
Arjun will guide Karthik on implementing OAuth2 authentication for the new batch upload endpoint.
Sneha must provide the API response schema to Divya by the end of the day.
Divya will serve as the primary guide for Rahul on any TypeScript-related challenges.
blockers: Vector embedding pipeline latency is 4 seconds per query, which is a blocker for meeting performance targets.
Frontend search UI development is blocked pending the final API response schema from Sneha.
risks: The high embedding latency is a significant risk for the client demo scheduled for April 14th. A fallback plan (using a smaller model) was mentioned if the primary fix is unsuccessful.
dependencies: Sneha's large-scale testing depends on Karthik completing the batch document upload endpoint.
Divya's completion of the search UI depends on Sneha providing the API response schema.
Karthik's implementation of the batch endpoint's authentication depends on guidance from Arjun.
Hariharan's client status email depends on receiving the performance benchmark report from Arjun.
next_steps: Arjun: Send performance benchmark report to Hariharan by tonight.
Arjun: Guide Karthik on authentication tomorrow morning.
Sneha: Share the API response schema with Divya by EOD today.
Sneha: Implement and test the sliding window approach to fix latency, due in 3 days (Thursday).
Karthik: Build the batch upload endpoint by Tuesday.
Karthik: Fix the two open medium-priority bugs by Wednesday.
Divya: Complete the search UI within 2 days after receiving the schema from Sneha.
Rahul: Finalize loading states and error handling on the frontend by Tuesday.
Meena: Begin regression testing from Thursday.
manager_actions: Schedule a mid-week check-in on Wednesday to review progress.
Send a status update email to the client today.
highlights: FastAPI endpoints for document ingestion are completed and deployed.
The frontend UI for document upload is complete.
Test cases for the document ingestion flow have been completed.
A critical bug identified by the testing team was fixed promptly by Arjun.

briefing.briefing_title: Enterprise RAG - Sprint 3 Mid-Week Check-in Briefing
what_was_discussed: Backend document ingestion endpoints are complete, but vector embedding latency is high at 4 seconds, far exceeding the 1-second target.
A plan was put in place for Sneha to fix the latency issue by implementing a sliding window chunking strategy.
The frontend search UI development was 70% complete but blocked, waiting for the API response schema from the backend.
The QA team completed ingestion test cases, finding several bugs which are now being addressed.
The team is focused on preparing for a critical client demo on April 14th.
what_was_decided: Sneha will implement a sliding window chunking strategy to reduce embedding latency, due Thursday.
Karthik will build a batch upload endpoint by Tuesday, with guidance from Arjun on authentication.
Sneha was to provide the final API response schema to Divya by EOD Monday to unblock frontend development.
Karthik will fix two medium-priority bugs by Wednesday.
what_to_follow_up: Confirm if Sneha delivered the API response schema to Divya. This was the primary blocker for the frontend team.
Check the status of the vector embedding latency. Has the new chunking strategy been implemented and what are the new performance metrics?
Verify if Karthik completed the batch upload endpoint, which was due Tuesday.
Confirm if the two medium-priority bugs assigned to Karthik have been resolved ahead of the Wednesday deadline.
Check on Divya's progress on the search UI, assuming she was unblocked.
open_questions: What is the current embedding latency? Are we meeting the 1-second target?
Is the batch upload endpoint complete and deployed for large-scale testing?
Is the frontend UI development back on track? What is the new estimated completion date?
What is our confidence level for the client demo on April 14th? Do we need to prepare the fallback plan (smaller model)?
Are there any new blockers that have emerged since Monday?
risks_to_watch: The high embedding latency remains the biggest risk to the project and the upcoming client demo. If Sneha's fix is insufficient, the demo will be compromised.
A cascading dependency exists where large-scale testing is dependent on the batch upload endpoint. Any delay from Karthik will impact Sneha's ability to validate her fix at scale.
The frontend UI has a compressed timeline. Any further delays or issues will risk it not being ready for the demo.
suggested_agenda: Review of embedding latency performance metrics (Sneha).
Status update and demo of the batch upload endpoint (Karthik).
Progress report on the frontend search UI and confirmation of unblocking (Divya).
